areyousure.title: ARE YOU SURE?
areyousure.question: Do you really want to %s?
areyousure.warning: This decision could change everything. Think carefully before going any further.
areyousure.passinfo: You can repeat this action until you do something else.
areyousure.challenge: An administrator wants to make sure you are human.
areyousure.captcha.prompt: Prove you are not a robot: type the code above.
areyousure.captcha.wrong: Wrong code (%s). Here is a new one.
areyousure.command.global: Are You Sure? is now %s for everyone without an override.
areyousure.command.only: Are You Sure? now only targets %s player(s).
areyousure.command.timeout: Idle pass timeout set to %s seconds (0 = never).
